This project may show the following, including but not limited to:

- Messy handwriting
- Strange comments

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2

npx cap open ios

# Phira Pro

Phira Pro is an **unofficial remix** of [Phira](https://github.com/TeamFlos/phira) v0.8.3.

While keeping the original gameplay and feel as unchanged as possible, it adds many features related to **practice, debugging, appearance customization, and local score management**, making it suitable for practicing high-difficulty charts, studying judgment feel, or creating custom appearances.

> **This project is an unofficial remix and has no relation to TeamFlos / the official Phira.**
> Any consequences arising from using this remix are borne by the user. Please do not report issues with this remix to the official project.

## Download

Download the Windows, macOS, and Linux archives, the Android arm64 APK, or the unsigned iOS IPA from the [Releases](https://github.com/Phira-Pro/Phira-Pro/releases) page. On Windows, extract the archive and run `phira-main.exe`; on macOS / Linux, run `phira-main`. Android updates keep app data; the iOS IPA must be signed and installed by yourself.

The current source version is **pro.19 development build** (in-app `0.8.3-pro.19`, build 96). It includes RPEN upgraded to **0.14.0**, and keeps chart video export, Plugin API v3, and PRCA replay analysis. It syncs upstream spatial trajectories, 2D movement, event value scaling, shader editing, and RPE Classic skins. Pro practice mode and chart library copies uniformly prepare shader source code to avoid missing dependencies. For the scope of the upgrade and container limitations, see the [pro.19 update notes](https://github.com/Phira-Pro/Phira-Pro/blob/HEAD/docs/development/pro-19.md). It carries forward pro.18-fix1's iOS mod loading fix, PEC content recognition, and touch event allocation optimization. Earlier additions include Early/Late hit text indicators, fixes for position and time handling on fast touches, unified judgment coordinates across different quality levels, and adjusted Android refresh rate requests and the iOS rendering driver. Three-finger gestures on mobile devices and actual high-refresh-rate effects still need verification on real devices; see the [touch and refresh rate notes](https://github.com/Phira-Pro/Phira-Pro/blob/HEAD/docs/development/input-display-feedback.md). Source versions and published attachments are maintained separately, so the actually downloadable version is determined by the Releases page.

It continues to keep pro.18-fix1's custom HUD resource pack preview follow fix, the Android audio recovery fix (retrying after switching to background on the results page), the official chart Hold length fix, and a switchable legacy display mode. …

PianoEthan/Orbit.body:
> [!NOTE]
> **Multi-module architecture and multi-platform adaptation**
>
> This project has been refactored into a "unified core + multi-platform UI" architecture:
> - `:core`: a cross-platform business core that carries low-level interface capabilities such as account credentials, WBI signing, user center data, feeds, search, and audio/video parsing, with no platform UI dependencies;
> - `:wear`: a client UI and haptic extension designed specifically for Wear OS watches, using Wear Material 3;
> - `:vision`: a client adapted for phones, tablets, and large TV screens (Orbit Vision), using standard Material 3 Expressive design and supporting both D-pad remote control and nine-key input.

A Wear OS rewrite of BiliTerminal.

## Introduction

Orbit is a third-party Bilibili client that runs on Wear OS smartwatches. It draws on some of BiliTerminal's API call patterns and UI design.

It is built with Jetpack Compose + Wear Material 3, and the network layer has been refactored to Retrofit + OkHttp, making it more modern than the original project.

Most basic features are already implemented, such as watching videos, browsing danmaku, posting comments, viewing feeds, watching live streams, offline caching, and more.

It includes Apsis Player, with switchable dual playback engines and dual danmaku engines, two-finger pinch-to-zoom and pan gestures, toggling danmaku on and off, dragging in fullscreen to adjust progress, and tapping the title area to exit.

It has some original distinctive features. On the recommendation page, swiping a video left removes it in one step (hide + report as not interested + block the UP主 (uploader)). In the comments section, long-pressing can hide a comment, delete your own comment, manage pinned comments on your own content, or block the sender. In feeds, long-pressing can pin, unpin, hide, or delete your own posts separately, and you can also block other publishers.

Note: the project is still in development, and some features are experimental. Please report bugs in the repository's issues. Contributions via pull requests are welcome.

## About Orbit Vision

Orbit Vision is a full-scenario Bilibili client built for large TV screens, tablets, foldable devices, and smartphones. It shares the cross-platform core `:core` with Orbit (Wear OS).

The UI is designed entirely with Jetpack Compose and the standard Material 3 Expressive guidelines. It supports an immersive layout without a top bar, and adaptively switches between a bottom navigation bar on phones and a sidebar (NavigationRail) on large screens. It offers dark, light, and Android 12+ dynamic wallpaper color schemes.

Currently supported features include: recommendation and trending feeds; video details and multi-part episode selection; UP主 (uploader) space and contribution viewing; following and blocking; related recommendations and series collections; full indexes for anime, domestic animation, movies, TV dramas, documentaries, and variety shows; multi-season switching and series tracking; image-text posts and a multi-image viewer; posting top-level and nested replies in comments; and Watch Later and multi-folder favorites management, among others.

The player is deeply tuned for the large-screen experience and uses ijkPlayer by default…

Scorp1o117/dsh-soul-md.body:
# DSH Soul / Persona

Simplified Chinese | [English](https://github.com/Scorp1o117/dsh-soul-md/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

Adds switchable persona cards and file-based long-term memory to [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). You can choose a persona for different workspaces or sessions, let the agent read and write memory as needed, and update the persona while using tools.

## Features

- **Persona cards**: Create and edit cards on the plugin page and set a default card. Choose a card for an individual session on the new session page or in the chat title bar, or hide the selector on the plugin page.
- **Workspace persona**: Set a default card for a workspace. Resolution order: session selection → workspace persona → default card → disabled.
- **File memory**: The agent can use `memory_read`, `memory_append`, and `memory_rewrite` to read and maintain memory, and `soul_read` and `soul_update` to read and update persona cards.
- **Layered memory**: By default, the always-resident `core.md` is kept separate from the topic-based `topics/*.md` files, which are read on demand. Supports `memory_search`, keyword recall, and post-compression compensation, and can be turned off as needed.
- **Per-persona memory control**: Memory is enabled by default for each card and can be turned off individually on the plugin page without affecting the persona itself.
- **Subagent control**: By default, personas and memory are not automatically injected into subagents. This does not change the read/write scope of the memory tools, and injection can be restored in settings.

Soul's memory is centered on files and personas. If you need conversation capture, model-based extraction, and vector recall, see [DSH TDAI Memory](https://github.com/Scorp1o117/dsh-tdai-memory). The two plugins can be used independently.

## Compatibility and installation

Supports DSH Web / Desktop. DSH allows all host versions from `0.2.0-rc.2` onward, including later prereleases. For the compatibility declaration, see [package.json](https://github.com/Scorp1o117/dsh-soul-md/blob/HEAD/package.json). Requires Node.js `>=20.18`.

DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` does not have an extension slot on the new session page, so you can continue to choose a persona from the session title bar.

On Desktop, first install the desktop `dsh` command in **App → Manage dsh commands**:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-soul-md
```

For Web, replace `desktop` with `web`. After installing, restart DSH and open **Plugins → Installed → dsh-soul-md**. You can also install via [Enhancement…

Vikrant-Aleph/dsh-opencode-bridge.description: Use OpenCode's free models in DeepSeek Harness by emulating the official client protocol.
Vikrant-Aleph/dsh-opencode-bridge.body:
# OpenCode Bridge

Chinese | [English](https://github.com/Vikrant-Aleph/dsh-opencode-bridge/blob/HEAD/README.us.md)

Use [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai)'s free models in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH), with no OpenCode account or API key required. It also includes optional context trimming and egress rotation.

## Key Features

**Disguises itself as the official OpenCode client so DSH can use OpenCode's free models.**

It replicates the request headers, the request shape required by the gateway, and the TLS and HTTP fingerprints of the official OpenCode client. It is an `LlmAdapter` that plugs into DSH's existing loop: the agent loop, permissions, and tool execution remain under DSH's control, and DSH parses each tool call itself. For what the gateway does and does not check, see [below](#opencode-如何判定客户端).

It also supports:

- **Automatic model refresh**: reads the free model list at startup and refreshes it every 10 minutes by default. Models are added or removed automatically when the upstream catalog changes. If a refresh fails, the previous usable list is kept.
- **Optional context trimming**: clears thinking only from turns that have been confirmed to complete successfully. Disabled by default.
- **Optional egress rotation**: configure multiple HTTP(S) or SOCKS proxies in order. It switches when it gets an explicit egress quota error or a connection failure, and always honors the wait times required by the server.

## Installation

### Installing in the DSH desktop app

1. Open **Plugins** in the sidebar, then click **Add Plugin** in the upper right.
2. Enter:

   ```text
   dsh-opencode-bridge@1.0.5
   ```

3. For **Install source**, prefer the official npm registry. Mirrors may lag behind.
4. Click **Install** and wait for it to finish.

### Command-line installation

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-opencode-bridge@1.0.5
```

Replace `desktop` with your profile. If `dsh` is not available in your terminal:

```sh
px @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-opencode-bridge@1.0.5
```

Then choose a model under **OpenCode Bridge** in the model selector. If it does not appear, restart that DSH profile.

Day-to-day use requires no API key and no hand-edited configuration files. When the model list changes, the selector is notified to reload it, so the plugin does not need to be restarted. …

angelky7/dsh-browser-control.body:
# DSH Browser Control

**Let AI do the work in your own browser: logged-in accounts, visible actions, and local files.**

## What is this

A dsh plugin plus a Chrome extension. The extension connects to dsh over local loopback (default `127.0.0.1:9777`), so the model can navigate, read pages, click, type, drag, upload, take screenshots, export PDF/MHTML, read and write cookies, and view performance metrics in **the browser you use every day**.

No headless mode, no moving login state around, and no MCP needed. It drives the Chrome on your screen that is already logged in.

- 30 `browser_*` tools that the agent can use with plain-language instructions
- Visible actions: tabs the agent opens automatically join the `DSH` group, and the extension popup locks them with one click
- Local gates: read-only, scripts disabled, upload allowlist
- Accountable: action audit plus a journal that persists across restarts
- Install the extension once: routine feature updates only require updating the plugin (extension-side security/platform fixes excepted)

## Installation

### 1. Chrome extension

Download [DSH-Browser-Control-v1.7.4.zip](https://github.com/angelky7/dsh-browser-control/releases/download/v1.7.13/DSH-Browser-Control-v1.7.4.zip), extract it to a fixed folder (don't delete it), open `chrome://extensions`, turn on Developer mode, click "Load unpacked", and select that folder. Requires Chrome 116+. A green dot on the icon means connected.

> If you installed v1.7.2, you don't need to reinstall. Feature updates v1.7.3–v1.7.10 don't require changes to the extension.

### 2. dsh plugin

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @angelky7/dsh-browser-control
```

Or from a GitHub tag:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:angelky7/dsh-browser-control#v1.7.13"
```

Offline package: [dsh-browser-control-plugin-v1.7.13.zip](https://github.com/angelky7/dsh-browser-control/releases/download/v1.7.13/dsh-browser-control-plugin-v1.7.13.zip). After extracting, run `dsh plugin --profile web add file:<that level>` on the level that contains `package.json`.

# Genshin Impact University Alliance

Welcome to the Genshin Impact University Alliance project! This project aims to collect and organize lists of Genshin Impact-related universities from across the country (currently 314 universities, 81 of which are valid), providing a campus hub.

Non-university entries can also be added~

5. **Add a domain name**: In the new folder on your branch, add your domain name by following the instructions in the README there.
6. **Open a Pull Request**: Open a Pull Request on GitHub to merge your changes into the original repository. Before opening the Pull Request, make sure your changes are accurate and have been tested.

# Cluefin

A research toolkit for independently investigating Korean stocks.

> This project is provided for educational and research purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice and does not guarantee any results.

## Why it was made

To properly examine a single stock, you have to collect and reconcile data from separate sources: prices from brokerage APIs, financials and disclosures from DART, interest rates and the economy from the Bank of Korea, and US customers and competitors from SEC. Cluefin brings these sources together in one client. On top of it, an AI agent can gather data and write verifiable judgments (reference price, stop-loss, invalidation conditions), and those judgments can later be checked against actual prices.

leimao2333/LEIMAOTV.body:
# 磊毛TV（LEIMAOTV）

> An all-in-one **IPTV live + on-demand movies/TV** player for Android TV: one remote, one interface, so you don't need to install two apps for live TV and films.
> **Playback starts as soon as you open it** (it resumes the last channel directly), and search in the live section **only matches six content types** (live channels, movies, anime, TV series, sports, variety shows).

This project is written by one person in their spare time. Details on TV such as focus, key handling, and startup have to be polished one at a time. If you feel it saves you time, you can buy me a drink:

**[→ Afdian tip (WeChat / Alipay supported)](https://ifdian.net/a/leimao)**

Tipping is entirely voluntary and **does not affect any features**. The app itself is free, has no ads, and donations unlock nothing. You can use all features without paying.

---

## Why this exists

The current situation on TV boxes is fragmented:

- **Live TV apps only handle live streams**. Switching channels is smooth, but to find a movie you have to exit and open another app.
- **On-demand apps only handle VOD**. Their poster walls look great, but if older family members want to watch the evening news, they need a separate entry point.
- **Search doesn't work across the two**. Searching for “Blossoms Shanghai” (繁花) in a live app returns nothing, and searching for “CCTV” in a film app is equally empty.
- **Opening the app shows a home screen first**. The most common TV use is “sit down and watch the news”, but you have to get through the home page, then the categories, then the channel list. Three steps before any picture appears, and older users often give up at this point.
- Remote control usually means a “phone interface scaled up to the TV”. Focus is invisible, buttons are hard to hit, and it's unclear where the back key will take you.

LEIMAOTV aims to solve these problems: **play on open, one app with two modes, one search with two kinds of results, and interaction designed for the remote from the start**.

## Three design principles

1. **Opening shows the picture, not a home page**
   A cold start plays the channel you watched last, without going through the home page, a list, or “continue watching”.
   Landing priority: last-watched channel → first favorite → first item in the channel list. You only see other pages in three cases: first launch, no sources, or channels not yet parsed (see [RULES.md](https://github.com/leimao2333/LEIMAOTV/blob/HEAD/RULES.md) §6.6).
   The home page is not an entry point but a **hub**. You reach it with the back button to switch modes, search, or manage sources.

2. **Switching modes is one key press, not an exit**
   At the top of the left navigation bar on the home page is the “Live / Film” mode switch. Press OK on the remote to toggle. Switching only changes the content area and leaves playback alone. A live stream can keep playing while you switch to Film to find a movie, then come back and continue watching. The player instance lives at the application layer and isn't destroyed with the page.

3. **Search in live mode is “cross-library”, with clear boundaries**
   Pressing the search key in the live section searches both the local channel library and the film library's **movies / anime / TV series / sports / variety shows** categories. …

# QuotaHub

Viewing quotas across multiple OpenCode Go, Ollama, and Mistral accounts is inconvenient, so I built a small tool that fetches and displays account quotas from each platform.

## Acknowledgements

Thanks to the members of the [LinuxDo](https://linux.do) community for their discussion and sharing;

The OpenCode Go quota query feature was implemented with reference to [opencode-cc](https://github.com/Kiowx/opencode-cc) ([@Kiowx](https://github.com/Kiowx)).

## Getting and Deploying

| Method | Who it suits | Description |
|------|--------|------|
| [GitHub Release](https://github.com/lvmiao233/QuotaHub/releases) | Most users | Provides Docker images, UV runtime packages, and source packages; the Release page has detailed instructions |
| Docker | Environments that already use Docker | See below |
| UV runtime package | Has [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) installed | After extracting, run `scripts/start.sh` (Linux/macOS) or `scripts\start.bat` (Windows) |
| Source package / Git clone | Need to change code or build it yourself | Requires uv; pnpm is also needed if you change the frontend |

## Docker Deployment

**Using the Release image (recommended):**

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/lvmiao233/quotahub:latest
docker run -d --name quotahub \
  -p 28787:8788 \
  -v ./data:/data \
  ghcr.io/lvmiao233/quotahub:latest
```

**Local build:**

```bash
cp docker-compose.yml.example docker-compose.yml
docker compose up -d --build --force-recreate
```

Open http://localhost:28787 in your browser (the port is set by `QUOTAHUB_LISTEN_PORT`)

Starting with **v0.4.1**, the GHCR images provide **linux/amd64** and **linux/arm64** (including arm64 soft routers / NAS). Both the `latest` and version-number tags are multi-arch manifests.

The data directory defaults to `./data` and contains the SQLite database `quotahub.db` and the service settings.

функция главная(): целое

    числа.добавить(10);

# operator

## CLI 1.3: desktop capabilities in the terminal

In 1.3.1, the role and character of Operator were clarified, and real information about the OS, CPU, and RAM was added. `system_info` checks current resources and, on request, the NVIDIA GPU. CLI startup is clean by default; details are available with `--verbose`. The skill catalog in the system prompt was shortened; full skill files are preserved. Repeated identical errors are recognized sooner, and useful long-running work is not limited by the number of steps.

CLI history, settings, and memory are stored on the device. When a cloud model is used, the request and the context passed with it are sent to its provider. Local storage does not mean that the network request is visible only to the owner.

The built-in tools `subagent`, `background_run`, `background_check`, `background_stop`, `github`, `browser`, `computer`, and `system_info` load automatically. Plugins and MCP are not carried over from the desktop. Qwen works with reasoning enabled; there is no thinking/no-thinking toggle. Models without reasoning support continue to work in their normal mode.

```bash
operator --doctor                  # check the environment without contacting the model
operator                           # interactive terminal…
